title: Post-gap opener — same relationship, not a fresh start
description: Mara opens session 2 with 'Hey. It's been a few weeks.' The companion has only session 1 history. It must pick up where they left off — Mara's tone, the relational context — without requiring her to re-establish who she is. It must not respond as if meeting her for the first time, ask basic questions already answered in session 1, or use a generic opener with no trace of the established history. The companion must acknowledge the gap without misrepresenting its length (it was about 3 weeks, not days or months).
pass_proves: The system maintains relational texture across a session gap and does not reset to generic-assistant voice.
fail_reveals: The system treats the gap as a full reset, meeting the user for the first time and losing all relational texture from session 1.
why_naive_fails: Retrieve-then-speak uses the companion-voice prefix ('I'm here for you as your companion') and loses all relational texture established in session 1.
